basis: May 9, 2024 is the earliest verified public disclosure of qualifying consolidated GAAP total revenue. Q1 2024 total revenue was $153,175,000 versus $162,092,000 a year earlier, down 5.50% and $812,400 below the $153,987,400 threshold. The April 24 earnings release disclosed only net product sales. The earliest date remains unconfirmed because the available record of the May 6 shareholder meeting covers voting results, and I could not verify management’s remarks at that meeting.

coverage.detail: The October 25, 2023 Q3 release said earlier Halloween shipments would adversely affect Q4 2023 sales. Its 2024 outlook concerned ingredient and packaging costs. It gave no Q1 2024 revenue bound.
The February 16, 2024 Q4 release reported 2023 product sales and discussed pricing limits and expected supply-chain improvement in 2024. It gave no numeric Q1 2024 revenue outlook.
The intervening 2023 Form 10-K discussed expected Q1 2024 timing for Canadian labor negotiations. I found no quarter-specific revenue forecast.

The April 24 Q1 release reported net product sales of $151,464,000 versus $160,711,000. For total revenue to qualify, Q1 rental and royalty revenue had to be at most $2,523,400. The release supplied neither that amount nor an upper bound.
Item 2.02 confirms the issuer made the earnings release public on April 24. The April 25 Form 8-K adds no revenue figures.

The issuer confirms the May 6 annual meeting and reports shareholder votes. Searches outside EDGAR for preliminary results, guidance, presentations, calls and meeting remarks yielded no earlier qualifying issuer statement or transcript establishing what management disclosed on May 6.

The Q1 Form 10-Q supplies the missing component. Rental and royalty revenue was $1,711,000 versus $1,381,000. Adding it to each quarter’s product sales reconciles exactly to the reported consolidated totals of $153,175,000 and $162,092,000.
EDGAR records acceptance of the Q1 Form 10-Q on May 9, 2024 at 15:00:40 for the quarter ended March 31, 2024.

publication_date_evidence: The April 24 release date and May 9 filing date are verified. The dollar amount is the May 9 reported actual. The unresolved May 6 meeting record prevents assigning May 9 as the definitive first public date.
